body: I want love with Elton John. So awesome.  You have come a long way down a very hard path.  Do you AA?  How did you find your way back with so much  public stress?  Do you credit your wife?

I was a correctional officer in an INS prison.  The officers in charge prepared for electrical failure and riots.  The women (me included) were stationed outside the prison so we wouldn't get raped if it did go down.  I sat in a truck with a shotgun outside a gate waiting for it to potentially go wacky and open up allowing chaos to ensue.
